title: Navigation
summary: Component contract for UI System navigation: shared NavLink/NavAction/NavCta/NavSection data shape, frontend SiteNav variants, backend AppShell variants, props, and usage rules.
notes: SPEC vs DOC ambiguity: guide-style prose with usage examples, but dominant content is TypeScript type contracts, per-component props tables, and hard rules (active marking, 4-6 top-level links, one primary CTA, icon-only buttons carry label); resolved to SPEC per ADR>SPEC>PRD>DOC rule. No frontmatter, no path/filename convention. Filename uses 'nosha256' instead of the 8-char SHA-256 path hash because this classifier had no shell to compute it; slug 'navigation' is unique under docs/.
